description: This file defines the main activity 'ActivityAnimations' for an Android app demonstrating custom activity transition animations. It manages a grid of photo thumbnails, applies grayscale filters, handles thumbnail click events to launch a detail activity with custom animations, and includes menu options to control animation speed.

classes.name: ActivityAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class managing a grid of photo thumbnails with custom transition animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid layout, loads photos, applies grayscale filters, and adds image views.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to adjust animation scale.

methods.name: thumbnailClickListener
methods.description: Click listener for thumbnails to launch the detail activity with custom transition effects.
